why: Standard Pyramid route from Maroon Lake via the NE ridge matches our Northeast Ridge.
Rock of Ages trailhead ascent is the standard Southwest Ridge per 14ers.com.
Track starts at the PUD lot (the Iowa Ave trailhead lot) and climbs the Chelan Butte trail to the summit.
Boston Basin trailhead to the West Ridge via the south-face couloir to the notch is the standard West Ridge; it is a car-to-car track so only the way up applies.
FKT is an up-and-down via the Skyline Divide trail and Chowder Ridge, matching our Skyline Divide route.
Trailhead-to-summit scramble via scree, meadow and ridge walk from FR 2419 is the standard scramble.
